required_checks: Independently verify the response contract from current source questions and reject the candidate if concept is not the correct type.
Verify the basic mark/sweep, copying-or-evacuation, and compaction distinctions without projecting textbook layouts onto every current HotSpot collector.
Verify the JDK 25 collector/version boundaries for Serial, Parallel, G1, ZGC and the server-class default-selection statement.
Verify the candidate's G1 region/evacuation description and its boundary that G1 combines multiple mechanisms rather than mapping to one textbook algorithm.
Check that Eden/Survivor wording is explicitly collector-scoped, tuning advice is evidence-driven, and no fabricated project experience is implied.
Check all source-question variants, oral-answer quality, followups, version specificity, and unsupported absolute claims.
review_contract.promotion_boundary: Do not promote or fabricate human approval. Pilot human review remains a separate mandatory gate when required by config.
